seed_rule: seed = base_seed + the circuit's index in series order
falsifier: one shot off a deterministic prediction (P = 0 or 1) refutes the circuit's implementation; any other prediction p refutes it at |z| >= 4.5, z = (k - n p) / sqrt(n p (1 - p))
counts_key: character n of a counts key is the bit of readout_qubits[n]
